order_rejected: Pull the reject code and the order ID from the gateway log
Compare the reject against the client's limits and the venue rule table
Check whether a limit file or security master load ran today
If a limit or table is wrong, raise it with the risk owner for approval
Ask the client to retry only after the fix is confirmed
order_stuck: Confirm order state at the OMS, not just the blotter
Check outbound queue depth and venue acknowledgement latency
Check deployments in the last 24 hours touching the OMS
If the queue is saturated, request approval to restart the consumer pool
Reconcile every affected order with the venue before telling clients they are safe
execution_failed: Bring in the senior engineer before any action
Fetch the execution report and the venue's record of the order
Check the router logs and any router release in the last 24 hours
List the affected orders and clients; quantify exposure
Any rollback goes through the change process; TradeSentinel cannot run it
fill_mismatch: Compare the fill across portal, OMS, drop copy and venue report
Check the drop copy sequence for gaps
Check allocation rules if a block trade is involved
Propose the corrected booking for post-trade approval
Confirm the position with the client after correction
session_connectivity: Check session state, sequence numbers and last heartbeat
Check certificate expiry and the network path status
Check whether other clients on the gateway are affected
Request approval for a sequence reset or a failover
access_howto: Check whether this is a question or a missing entitlement
Share the matching guide if it is a question
If access is missing, get the manager's approval and grant the role
If anything suggests unauthorised access, stop and escalate to security
